_description: AI strategic thresholds. Resolution order (highest priority first): per-civ override → active strategy → game phase modifier → defaults. Read via GameManager.get_ai_tunable(civ_id, path, default).

expansion._comment: Settler production brakes and max city targeting

strategies._comment: Strategy archetypes. Each lists overrides layered on top of defaults. The active strategy is picked per-turn by _pick_strategy() in ai_controller based on leader flavor, neighbors, economy, and game phase. Paths use dot-notation relative to the top of ai.json.

balanced._description: Default — mild preferences, adapts to situation. Used when no other strategy strongly matches.

wide._description: Many smaller cities. Emphasize expansion, settlers, low per-city garrison.

tall._description: Few large cities. Cap city count early, focus on growth/buildings in each.

warmonger._description: Military buildup, aggressive wars. More units, higher floors.

builder._description: Economy/wonders. Strong buildings, minimal military, maximize science.

science._description: Rush tech. Fewer cities, libraries/universities priority, low military.

cultural._description: BTS cultural victory: 6-9 cities with 3 legendary culture cities. Pacifism + Free Speech + temples/cathedrals/wonders/artists. Per https://forums.civfanatics.com/threads/the-beginners-crash-guide-to-cultural-victory.160306/

phases._comment: Game phase modifiers. early_turn_end/mid_turn_end gate which phase is active. Values at each phase layer on top of strategy + defaults.

early._description: First 100 turns — prioritize expansion, basic infrastructure, cheap military.

mid._description: T100-250 — consolidate, build economy, scale military with threats.

late._description: T250+ — maximize wonders/tech, strong military cap, slow expansion.
